cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've found our wedding video. Shall we watch it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Here's your father's speech. We never could agree what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant exactly this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paused. Let's skip to the dancing, then. No speeches. You can help me settle whether your uncle actually falls into the cake.

mechanism: A claims to have taught film interpretation and redirects a separated spouse toward increasingly safe parts of their wedding video.
confusable: Not discussing the marriage through memories: A rejects the relevant interpretation and offers another viewing assignment.
comparison: Practical picnic correction versus critical-viewing lesson.
seedUse: D86 wedding video/father/speeches/dance; S05 teaches pupil what to focus on.
